title: PARKING - MAINTENANCE PRACTICES
question: What are the key steps to properly prepare and secure an airplane on a level surface before installing the control column lock?
answer: Hard Surface and Sod. (1)  Position airplane on level surface headed into wind. (2)  Set parking brake or chock main gear wheels. CAUTION: Do not set parking brake during cold weather.  Accumulated moisture may freeze brakes, or when brakes are overheated. (3)  Install control column lock.
